text.en: In pancreatic exocrine insufficiency, the problem is that the intestinal lining itself is damaged and cannot absorb nutrients -- in reality, pancreatic exocrine insufficiency's problem is at an earlier step, digestion: without adequate pancreatic enzymes, fats, proteins, and carbohydrates are never properly broken down into absorbable forms in the first place, so the intestinal lining itself can be completely healthy and still absorb almost nothing, since there is nothing correctly digested left to absorb.
text.et: Pankrease eksokriinse puudulikkuse puhul on probleem selles, et soolestiku vooder ise on kahjustatud ega suuda toitaineid imada -- tegelikult on pankrease eksokriinse puudulikkuse probleem varasemas sammus, seedimises: ilma piisavate pankrease ensüümideta ei lagundata rasvu, valke ja süsivesikuid kunagi korralikult imenduvateks vormideks, mistõttu soolestiku vooder ise võib olla täiesti terve ja siiski peaaegu mitte midagi imenduda, kuna imenduda pole midagi korralikult seeditud jäänud.
